metadata.name: Uno-Class Linear Temperature Monitor and LCD Result

components.value: Program Temperature monitor; ADC A0; Output D8; Format 0.0 C
Temperature 25 C; Scale 10 mV/C; Offset 0 mV

nonPhysicalItems.reason: Shared return net for the board and supply.

physicalNotes: Install U1 with pin 1 at F10 and program its internal 8 MHz clock without division. A0 is PC0 and D8 is PB0.
Use insulated pigtails for LM35DZ leads 1 (+5 V), 2 (OUT), and 3 (GND). Cable J2 signals GND, +5 V and RX to the matching markings on the off-board LCD.

nonPhysicalItems.reason: External stimulus or supply connects through J1.
Shared return net for the board and supply.

pcbFabrication.fabricationNotes: J1 supplies regulated 5 V and return. LM35DZ drives A0. Form the center lead to the staggered land pattern. D8 drives the off-board LCD RX through J2. Program U1 for the internal 8 MHz oscillator without division.
